note: Draft authorization manifest per evidence/M1_FINAL/02_protocol/run_policy.md section 3. It grants NOTHING until status is APPROVED and the approval block holds the Research Lead's verbatim approval text and timestamp; its SHA-256 is then recorded in an AUTHORIZATION_RECORDED event and passed to the CLI. Following the M4.2 precedent, this file stays untracked during execution and is committed with the results.

workbook_task.title: Run the full deployable baseline evaluation
workbook_task.deliverable: Predictions and fair baseline table with oracle rows separated

purpose: Evaluate the seven frozen deployable baselines and the M4.3 frozen QPAF on the 171 ViDoSeek validation queries, select the strongest deployable baseline (co-strongest within 1e-12), compute single-seed exploratory paired QPAF-minus-baseline statistics, and, separately, W7/W66 oracle context rows on the same pool. Handover to Thanh for the M4.5 fairness/uncertainty audit.

decisions.split: validation only, confirmed by the Research Lead on 2026-10-23 (test 172 stays sealed)
decisions.oracle: new W7/W66 oracle rows on the same validation pool, confirmed by the Research Lead on 2026-10-23; frozen profiles only, no other search

git.tracked_state_policy: git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no must be empty and HEAD must equal source_commit; the CLI refuses otherwise.
git.user_tracked_edit: .gitignore carries the Research Lead's own uncommitted edit; it is stashed for the execution and restored right after, never committed.

m42_bundle.restore: scripts/run_m44_evaluation.py restore-inputs copied the seven Git-ignored files from byte-identical local sources; scripts/run_m42_active_primary.py --verify returned PASS

split.labels_deserialized: validation qrels only; train qrels are not used; test qrels are never opened

QPAF-M4_4-MTH-001.claim_scope: Validation-only, single-seed development evidence: deployable baseline table, strongest-baseline selection and exploratory paired statistics. Learned checkpoints were selected on this split (optimistic). Becomes scientific_result only after the M4.5 independent review; no test, confirmation or three-seed claim.
QPAF-M4_4-MTH-001.wall_time_basis: Label-free preflight (scoring, checkpoint reload and CSV writing, no metric) took 29.4 s.

QPAF-M4_4-ORC-001.claim_scope: Non-deployable label-using upper bounds on the same validation pool (global, per-query and per-page W7/W66 oracles). Context only; never eligible for strongest-baseline selection; not learned or deployable improvement.
QPAF-M4_4-ORC-001.wall_time_basis: Synthetic same-size timing probe (no labels): about 145 s for W7 and 231 s for W66 on 171 queries.

executor: Claude Code at the Research Lead's request
hardware: Local CPU only (Windows 11); no GPU, no Modal

limits.wall_time_enforcement: The run checks elapsed time after scoring and after every oracle query; exceeding the cap fails closed with _FAILED.json.
limits.retry_rule: A fresh attempt needs a reviewed reason, a new run_id (A02) with retry_of, a new namespace and a new authorization.

output.create_once_rule: The CLI refuses an existing namespace and writes _ATTEMPTED.json before any label-bearing work; exactly one of _SUCCESS.json/_FAILED.json follows.

stop_conditions: authorization, config, bundle, freeze, checkpoint or saved-prediction hash drift
M4.2 bundle verification fails or a restored file differs
development qrels contain a test query ID, or validation candidate coverage below 0.95 or any uncovered query
learned QARF or QPAF reload differs from the saved predictions by more than 1e-7
non-finite score or metric, missing or extra query or candidate row
wall time above the experiment cap
dirty tracked tree, HEAD not equal to source_commit, or namespace already exists
pre_run_checks: scripts/run_m42_active_primary.py --verify on the restored bundle returns PASS

boundaries.next_step: Hand over to Thanh for the M4.5 independent train-only, paired-delta, tie, hash and uncertainty review; M4.6 then freezes the main-method direction.
